channel.title: AI Chips & Data Centres Daily
channel.description:
The silicon, the buildings and the power behind AI. Every day: the chips and systems that shipped, the data centres that broke ground or switched on, the grid and cooling constraints that decide where they go, and the supply chain and export rules underneath it all — with the numbers. Engineering and capex first, never hype.
